thread:
alex: Quick docs PR up for 'usage alerting' — covers spend alerts, rate/quota thresholds, and a recommended SDK header. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

maria: skimmed. overall good, but the header name in the curl example is old (`X-Quota-User`). we use `X-RW-Quota` now. also we should call out burst-credit interaction (how burst credits postpone quota alerts).

sam: I can update the snippets (curl, python, ts). there's a 404 on the dashboard link in the alerting section (the panel id path). where should that point?

alex: thanks. prefer hosted examples by default, but add a short 'Dedicated notes' section explaining metric namespaces and reserved pools. the dashboard link should point to the 'Usage & Spend' panel (not the old alerts page).
jordan: I'll add the Dedicated note — main difference: metrics use the `reserved` tag and don't include cross-tenant routing; also rollup windows are 1m vs 30s on hosted. callout will be short.

olivia: tiny product ask: confirm pricing tier names in examples — we use Starter / Scale / Enterprise in billing. current thresholds in the doc use 'Pro' which is outdated. update those to avoid confusion.

docs-bot: Notice: /docs/alerts/dashboards -> 404 (redirect loop). Issue filed #1234 and assigned to @infra.

sam: ok pushing change: replace header -> `X-RW-Quota: tier=Scale;limit=100000` and add example curl + python snippet. will also fix dashboard link to /console/insights/usage-spend. example curl I'll add in PR:```\ncurl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\
     -H "X-RW-Quota: tier=Scale;limit=100000" \\
     "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/alerts/subscribe"\n```

maria: add note that alerts should use `cost_estimate_usd` for spend thresholds and `token_count` for token-based alerts. mention embeddings are tracked under `embedding_count` and bill differently.

alex: action items: (1) Sam update snippets (py/ts/curl) and fix link by EOD, (2) Jordan add Dedicated section, (3) Maria add metric name clarifications + burst-credit bullet, (4) Olivia confirm tier thresholds. I'll request final review once commits are up.

sam: on it — will tag @alex @maria when opened. :thumbsup:

jordan: added a short draft in the doc for Dedicated callout (pushed to the PR branch). needs wording check.

alex: perfect, thanks everyone — once we merge we should backfill the release notes and add a short snippet to the SDK samples page.
